﻿modes:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Base Modes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  default:
    includeType: ["*"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build", ".git"]
    
  docs-only:
    includeType: [".md", ".txt"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build", ".git"]

  yaml:
    includeType: [".yaml"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", ".git"]

  json:
    includeType: [".json"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", ".git"]

  ts:
    includeType: [".ts"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build"]

  py:
    includeType: [".py"]
    excludeFolders: ["__pycache__", ".git"]

  copilot:
    includeFolders: [".github"]
    includeType: [".md", ".txt"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build"]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Composite / Inherited Modes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  summary-docs:
    extends: "docs-only"
    ignoreType: [".txt"]
    excludeFolders: ["drafts", "archive"]

  code-only:
    includeType: [".ts", ".py", ".ps1", ".psm1", ".psd1"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build", "__pycache__", ".git"]

  config-only:
    includeType: [".json", ".yaml"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build", ".git"]

  config-clean:
    extends: "config-only"
    excludeFolders: ["archive", "legacy"]

  ts-docs:
    extends: "ts"
    includeType: [".ts", ".md"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build"]

  py-docs:
    extends: "py"
    includeType: [".py", ".md"]
    excludeFolders: ["__pycache__", ".git"]

  analysis:
    includeType: [".md", ".yaml", ".json"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build", "__pycache__", ".git"]

  frontend:
    includeType: [".ts", ".md", ".json"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build"]

  backend:
    includeType: [".py", ".json", ".yaml"]
    excludeFolders: ["__pycache__", ".git", "dist", "build"]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Highly Filtered / Specialized Modes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  docs-minimal:
    extends: "docs-only"
    ignoreType: [".txt"]
    excludeFolders: ["drafts", "samples", "archive", "temp"]

  config-schema:
    extends: "config-only"
    includeFolders: ["schema"]
    excludeFolders: ["node_modules", "dist", "build", ".git"]

  copilot-clean:
    extends: "copilot"
    excludeFolders: ["drafts", "samples"]
